title: Holiday Gingerbread Tealight Holder Set
body_html:
The Holiday Gingerbread Tealight Holder Set from Blomus brings a touch of whimsy and refined elegance to your seasonal tabletop. Expertly pairing delicate white porcelain silhouettes with a warm, organic acacia wood base, this set creates a captivating winter village scene. When illuminated by candlelight, the intricate cutouts cast a soft, magical glow, offering a sophisticated Scandinavian-inspired aesthetic that perfectly elevates your mantel or dining centerpiece during the festive months.

Highlights:

  • Crafted from high-quality white porcelain and acacia wood
  • Partially hand-crafted construction
  • Inspired by classic gingerbread house motifs
  • Designed for a soft, ambient glow when paired with tealights
  • Versatile scale ideal for mantels or coffee tables
  • Complements both modern and traditional holiday décor styles
  • Available in White color

title: Juhla Ornament (Set of 8)
body_html:
The Juhla Ornament (Set of 8) from Blomus brings a refined, sculptural elegance to your holiday decor. Each piece is meticulously crafted from hand-blown glass, featuring a sophisticated matte finish that captures the light with understated grace. Suspended by custom-printed satin ribbons, these ornaments evoke the essence of a Nordic celebration. Their deep, contemporary color palette offers a modern update to traditional seasonal trimmings, perfect for creating a curated, festive atmosphere.

Highlights:

  • Set of 8
  • Adjustable printed ribbon for hanging - maximum ribbon length 7.3 inches
  • Features adjustable printed ribbon for customized hanging heights
  • Elegant matte finish available in a curated palette of festive colors
  • Designed to bring a modern, minimalist aesthetic to seasonal decor
  • Arrives in a beautifully presented gift box

title: Kitai Glass Ornament with Ring (Set of 4)
body_html:
The Kitai Glass Ornament with Ring (Set of 4) from Blomus infuses your seasonal decor with a refined touch of Scandinavian minimalism. Each hand-blown glass bauble is cradled within a sleek metallic ring, creating a captivating play of light and reflection. Finished with a coordinating satin ribbon, these delicate ornaments bring an elevated sense of warmth and sophisticated elegance to your holiday display, embodying the collection's namesake sentiment of hope.

Highlights:

  • Kitai Collection
  • Hand-blown glass construction paired with a modern silver ring
  • Includes a set of 4 ornaments presented in a gift box

title: Thatched Roof Houses and Figurines Set
body_html:

title: Vela Candle Holder
body_html:
The Vela Candle Holder from Blomus reimagines the timeless tradition of Advent through a modern, sculptural lens. Crafted from textured stoneware with a sophisticated matte glaze, this versatile piece serves as an elegant foundation for seasonal displays or everyday dining. Its spacious central tray invites creative curation, allowing you to fill the void with ornaments, botanicals, or seasonal accents, bringing a warm, tactile presence to your home throughout the entire year.

Highlights:

  • Candle holder holds 4 candles
  • Accommodates four standard 0.9 inches taper candles
  • Features a generous central basin for customized seasonal decor
  • Durable stoneware construction with a refined matte aesthetic
